accepted.question_text: Let q be a non-root of unity. The q-Onsager algebra is the algebra generated by W_0 and W_1 subject to the pair of q-Dolan-Grady type relations written in the paper, namely [W_0,[W_0,[W_0,W_1]_q]_{q^{-1}}]=ρ[W_0,W_1] and [W_1,[W_1,[W_1,W_0]_q]_{q^{-1}}]=ρ[W_1,W_0], where [X,Y]_q=qXY-q^{-1}YX and ρ is a scalar. The algebra A_q is an infinite-dimensional current algebra introduced in terms of generators {W_{-k}, W_{k+1}, G_{k+1}, G̃_{k+1} | k ∈ ℤ_+} whose first modes satisfy the same pair of relations. There is also an explicit homomorphism from the q-Onsager algebra to a coideal subalgebra of U_q(\hat{sl}_2) sending W_0 to k_+e_1 + k_-q^{-1}f_1q^{h_1} + ε_+q^{h_1}, W_1 to k_-e_0 + k_+q^{-1}f_0q^{h_0} + ε_-q^{h_0}, and ρ to (q+q^{-1})^2k_+k_-. Show that these three infinite-dimensional algebras — A_q, the q-Onsager algebra, and that coideal subalgebra of U_q(\hat{sl}_2) — are isomorphic.
accepted.context_brief: Isomorphism between A_q, q-Onsager, and a coideal subalgebra

evidence.quote: Studying in details the algebraic structure of the most general (non-scalar) solution of the reflection equation algebra - the so-called Sklyanin operator [Sk] - an infinite dimensional current algebra called Aq was identified in 2005 [BK], which first modes satisfy the above pair of relations. Precisely, Aq is defined in terms of generators {Wk, Wk+1, Gk+1, G˜ k+1|k ∈ Z+} and defining relations given in [BK].
According to a certain choice of coproduct structure for Uq(slc2), it reads W0 ↦ k+e1 + k−q−1 f1q h1 + ǫ+q h1 , W1 ↦ k−e0 + k+q−1 f0q h0 + ǫ−q h0 , ρ ↦ (q + q−1 )2 k+k−.
Problem 1-a: Show that the infinite dimensional algebra Aq, the q−Onsager algebra and the above coideal subalgebra of Uq(slc2) are isomorphic.

accepted.question_text: Let A_q^{diag} denote the current algebra obtained from the quotient of the reflection equation algebra discussed in the paper, with current modes K_k, K_{k+1}, Z_{k+1}, and Z̃_{k+1}. Let the augmented q-Onsager algebra be the algebra generated by K_0, K_1, Z_1, and Z̃_1 subject to the displayed commutation and higher q-commutator relations in the paper. There is also an explicit homomorphism from the augmented q-Onsager algebra to a coideal subalgebra of U_q(\hat{sl}_2) sending K_0 to ε_+q^{h_1}, K_1 to ε_-q^{h_0}, Z_1 to (q^2-q^{-2})(ε_+q^{-1}e_0q^{h_1}+ε_-f_1q^{h_1+h_0}), and Z̃_1 to (q^2-q^{-2})(ε_-q^{-1}e_1q^{h_0}+ε_+f_0q^{h_1+h_0}). Show that the infinite-dimensional algebra A_q^{diag}, the augmented q-Onsager algebra, and that coideal subalgebra of U_q(\hat{sl}_2) are isomorphic.
accepted.context_brief: Isomorphism for the augmented q-Onsager setting

evidence.quote: Remarquably, considering a certain quotient of the reflection equation algebra2 one obtains a new current algebra [BB2]. Let us denote Adiag q as the algebra generated by the currents’ modes Kk,Kk+1, Zk+1, Z˜ k+1.

Importantly, an explicit homomorphism from the augmented q−Onsager algebra to another coideal subalgebra of Uq(slc2) is known [IT, BB2]. It reads: K0 ↦ ǫ+q h1 , K1 ↦ ǫ−q h0 , Z1 ↦ (q2 − q−2 )(ǫ+q−1 e0q h1 + ǫ−f1q h1+h0 ), Z˜1 ↦ (q2 − q−2 )(ǫ−q−1 e1q h0 + ǫ+f0q h1+h0 ).

Problem 1-b: Show that the infinite dimensional algebra Adiag q , the augmented q−OA and the above coideal subalgebra of Uq(slc2) are isomorphic; Find the polynomial formulae which relates Adiag q to the augmented q−OA.

When N=1 this quotient is isomorphic to the Askey-Wilson algebra AW(3), and there is a known homomorphism from AW(3) to the double affine Hecke algebra of type C_1,C_1^∨. Is there a homomorphism from A_q^{[2N+1]} to an algebra that generalizes the double affine Hecke algebra of type C_1,C_1^∨?

For N = 1, it is isomorphic with the Askey-Wilson algebra AW(3) [Zhedanov,1991]. In addition, recall that there exists an homomorphism from AW(3) to the double affine Hecke algebra of type C1, C∨ 1 [Terwilliger,2010].
Problem 2-a: Is there an homomorphism from A [2N+1] q to an algebra that generalizes the double affine Hecke algebra of C1, C∨ 1 ?
